verdict.rationale: Skyfire exposes an MCP server whose tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token) let an agent invoke its identity/payment functions programmatically, which supports agent-driven (natural-language-mediated) operation, but this is tool-call/API orchestration via MCP rather than documented natural-language command parsing or a conversational interface. missing for 10: no evidence of a chat/NL interface accepting free-form commands, no examples of natural-language instructions being translated into Skyfire actions, no independent/hands-on confirmation of NL usability.
